text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has kicked off for King Halo! She announces the lodge will one day become famous as the place she once trained at. But her ambitious renovation plans lack her usual enthusiasm in the intense heat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The main thing on her mind is installing an air conditioner, which seems rather modest for a dreamer like King Halo.
